verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents cross-meeting search. It offers a 'Meeting search' feature, an API keyword filter over meeting titles and words spoken, and AskFred, which can search across multiple meetings. Nothing in the pack shows that search covers summaries and notes, or that results jump to the exact timestamp where something was said. Missing for 10: evidence of search over summaries/notes, timestamp-level jump-to-moment from results, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: Allows searching for keywords in meeting title and/or words spoken during the meeting
Transcribe, summarize, search, and analyze all your team conversations.
